name: Model Evaluation and Benchmarking
description: Model-level evaluation done rigorously: how benchmarks are scored, why the same model gets different numbers in different harnesses, how contamination and saturation distort leaderboards, how to build your own eval suite with statistics you can defend, and how to evaluate reasoning, agentic and safety capabilities.

image.caption: Wirewalk Institute of AI badge: Model Evaluation and Benchmarking

criteria.narrative:
To earn this certificate a learner must: complete all 20 lessons in 6 modules; and pass the final exam: 25 questions, 60 minutes, pass mark 80%, at most 3 attempts, with a 24-hour wait after a failed attempt.

The exam is taken online and is not proctored. The holder's identity is not verified; the name is the one on their account. This is a certificate of completion and assessment issued by Wirewalk Institute of AI. It is not an accreditation, academic credit, license, or a certification from any vendor. Details: https://institute.wirewalk.com/certification/#limits
